channel.title: summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Ozempic and Wegovy tied to fewer asthma attacks
item.description: A large real-world study linked semaglutide, found in Ozempic and Wegovy, to nearly 40% fewer asthma attacks, with additional associations observed.

item.title: Scientists remain skeptical of alien life claims
item.description: Two major alien-life announcements in 2025 drew widespread excitement, yet most astrobiologists were unconvinced. Only 6.6% of surveyed experts agreed.

item.title: Bone-Building Switch May Offer New Target for Osteoporosis
item.description: An experimental compound, AP503, strengthened bones in mice by activating GPR133, a receptor that promotes bone formation while slowing bone loss.

item.title: Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS Found Rich in Methanol
item.description: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS contains unusually high levels of methanol, indicating it formed under conditions very different from those in our solar system.
